description: The wgpu shell's transient notice as an assistive technology meets it (ticket 26/09/30 NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING, W2-C follow-up 4, W3-E2E P2). React renders the notice as `role=status`, `aria-live=polite` with the localized message as its text and the machine code on `data-notice-code`. The wgpu shell paints it, so it projects it into the ARIA mirror as the one polite status node `node`: named by the localized `message`, described by the `code` (no description when the notice carries none), never focusable nor actionable (its close button is its own hit). A notice past its 4 s deadline or dismissed projects nothing. Every `notices` row is shown in its `locale` and must project exactly `node` with that label and description.
